response.text:
I can do that, but I need a few things before I take any destructive action.

What I need from you
- Exact event/series to cancel (copy the calendar event title as shown in your calendar).
- Day, local start time, and time zone (e.g., Thursdays 10:00–11:00 AM, America/Los_Angeles).
- Which scope you want:
  - a) Cancel only one occurrence (give date), or
  - b) Cancel all future occurrences from a given date (give effective date), or
  - c) Cancel the entire recurring series (removes past and future series entry from calendars).
- Do you want me to notify all attendees with the standard cancellation notice? (yes/no)
- Any message to include in the cancellation notification (optional).

Consequences and risks (please confirm you accept)
- Attendees will see the meeting removed from their calendars if you notify them.
- People who rely on the slot for work may lose coordinated time or miss the change.
- Any meeting notes, recordings, or linked docs remain but might be harder to find if series removed.
- This action is reversible only by recreating the meeting; existing RSVPs and conference links may be lost.

Reversible alternatives you might consider instead
- Pause the series for N weeks.
- Change frequency (e.g., biweekly) or shorten the meeting.
- Send an agenda/async updates instead of a meeting.
- Ask attendees for feedback or trial a pause.

Explicit confirmation required
Reply with one of these exact confirmations (or provide the requested details and choose option):
1) "Cancel entire series: [Event title], Thursdays [time] [timezone]. Notify attendees: yes/no. Message: [optional]" 
2) "Cancel all future occurrences from [date]: [Event title], Thursdays [time] [timezone]. Notify attendees: yes/no. Message: [optional]"
3) "Cancel single occurrence on [date]: [Event title], [time] [timezone]. Notify attendees: yes/no. Message: [optional]"

I will not perform any action until you reply with one of the explicit confirmation lines above and the event details.
